title: Container Bookings: Amendment Allowances, Deadlines and Destination Change Rates by Tier
content:
Amendments to a live Container Bookings booking are governed by tier settings for the free allowance, the fee beyond it, the latest moment an amendment may arrive, whether the port of discharge may be changed and at what per-container rate, and how far the container quantity may grow.

## Tier settings

| Booking product | Amendments free of fee per booking | Amendment fee beyond the allowance (USD) | Latest receipt, in hours ahead of the cargo cut-off | Change of port of discharge permitted | Change-of-destination rate (USD per container) | Largest quantity increase (percent of the confirmed count) |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| AHL Spot Saver | 1 | 75.00 | 72 | no | 0.00 | 0 |
| AHL Spot Flex | 2 | 60.00 | 48 | yes | 350.00 | 25 |
| AHL Contract Booking | 3 | 50.00 | 48 | yes | 300.00 | 50 |
| AHL Contract Priority | 5 | 40.00 | 24 | yes | 250.00 | 50 |
| AHL Guaranteed Loading | 3 | 50.00 | 48 | no | 0.00 | 0 |
| AHL Premium Express | 6 | 35.00 | 24 | yes | 300.00 | 25 |

## Reading the table

- A change of port of discharge is closed to AHL Spot Saver and AHL Guaranteed Loading; for them the change-of-destination rate reads 0.00 because no such change can arise.
- A percentage of 0 means the product allows no increase of the container quantity by amendment.
- The percentage is taken of the container count confirmed on the booking, and the permitted increase is rounded down to whole containers.

## Hypothetical rounding illustration

On a booking confirmed for 7 containers, a 25 percent limit gives 1.75, which rounds down to 1 additional container; a 50 percent limit gives 3.5, which rounds down to 3. The container counts are invented for illustration, and any increase remains subject to space on the sailing.
